incident.source_message_en:
The following road sections are busy:
Hong Kong Island
– Connaught Road Central (Western Harbour Crossing bound)
– Connaught Road Central Flyover (Western Harbour Crossing bound)
– Connaught Road West (Western Harbour Crossing bound)
– Harcourt Road (Western Harbour Crossing bound)
– Gloucester Road (Western Harbour Crossing bound)
– Island Eastern Corridor (Eastern Harbour Crossing bound)
Motorists passing through the above road sections are advised to drive with utmost care and patience.
